resources.string: Shows the circle/card float bar. The screen is captured only when you tap the circle button, so you can circle a question and send it to the AI.
Sends after a 1-second pause; keep drawing to extend the circle%1$s
Write something on the pad first
Too short: tap once to start talking, tap again when you\'re done.
Speech recognition failed; check the network and try again.
Didn\'t catch that, please say it again.
Microphone allowed. Go back to the answer card (tap the card button on the float bar) and tap 🎤 Ask to start talking.
Microphone access is needed to ask by voice.
No answers yet. Tap the circle button and circle a question first.
Circle a question, tap once, and get just the hint you need right now.

Only needs \"Display over other apps\" (some phones call it \"Floating window\"); no accessibility needed. The first time you tap the circle button the system asks once for screen-capture permission, then screenshots work directly; after a restart, or if capture was stopped, it asks again on the next tap. Screenshots stay in memory and are never saved to the gallery. If the float bar disappears after a while, opening Quanwen brings it back; you can also allow Quanwen to run in the background in system settings.
On the page that opens, allow Quanwen to display over other apps, then come back.
The accessibility float bar is already on.
The overlay didn\'t start. Try again, or use accessibility mode instead.
Float bar is on. The screen is captured only when you tap the circle button, and nothing is saved to the gallery.
Screenshot failed: the system sent no picture (%1$s). Tap the circle button again to allow capture again; if it still fails, try accessibility mode.
This device needs a different capture method: tap the circle button again, then allow screen capture.
Screen capture has stopped. Tap the circle button again to allow it.

Turn on \"Quanwen float bar\" in the system accessibility settings. If the switch is greyed out, open App info, choose \"Allow restricted settings\" from the top-right menu, then come back and turn it on.
New session started; earlier questions will no longer be sent as context
No API key yet: open AI service in settings, enter a key (OpenAI, DeepSeek and others work), then tap Test connection.
Without the float bar: circle in the app

Works even where accessibility can\'t be turned on (for example HarmonyOS with Zhuoyitong). Split the screen: notes on one half, Quanwen on the other. Tap Screenshot on the circle page (never saved to the gallery; in split screen Quanwen crops out its own half), or take a system screenshot and Quanwen loads it automatically, then circle right here; you can also drag the screenshot thumbnail straight into Quanwen. Or pick an image from the gallery, paste one, or photograph paper notes.
Circle your question%1$s; pinch to zoom. New screenshots load automatically.
Load an image with the buttons above (latest screenshot, screenshot — temporary, never saved to the gallery — gallery or paste), or drag a screenshot here.
Photo access is needed to read the latest screenshot; you can also pick one from the gallery.
This is a new session. Circle a question to start; nothing from other sessions is carried over. Tap ☰ at the top right to switch back to another session.
Quanwen can take screenshots (used only on the circle page, never saved to the gallery; stops when you leave the page)
Screenshot failed: the system sent no picture (%1$s). Tap Screenshot again to allow it again; if it still fails, take a system screenshot and Quanwen loads it automatically.
Screenshot failed: the picture came back black (%1$s); this screen may block capture. Try a system screenshot instead.
Screen capture was stopped by the system. Tap Screenshot again to allow it.
This device needs a different capture method. Please allow screen capture once more.
No image on the clipboard. Copy a screenshot first, then tap Paste.
Couldn\'t get an image: this source doesn\'t support dropping here. Try Latest screenshot, Gallery or Paste.
Delete \"%1$s\"? All its pages are deleted too and can\'t be recovered.
Circle the question with the highlighter; it goes to the AI when you pause for 1 second%1$s. Each circle opens its own answer box, which stays until you tap ×.
; after circling you can write a mark to switch mode (%1$s)
Eraser: rubs out whatever it passes over; undo if you erase too much. While the eraser is on, the three widths on the left set its size. If your pen has an eraser end, flip it over to erase.
Picture deleted; tap Undo to bring it back
You can now drag pictures on the page; tap the × on a picture to delete it. You can also long-press a picture to delete it.

The picture is on the page. Drag it now, or tap the × at its corner to delete it; when it\'s in place, tap Move pictures in the toolbar to go back to writing. Later, long-press a picture to delete it.
Pinned to the page. To move it, tap Move pictures in the toolbar first; long-press it to delete it.
Couldn\'t keep this answer. Drag the answer box fully on screen and try again.
After circling, write a few letters outside the circle to get a different kind of answer that time. Current marks: %1$s
After circling, write a few letters outside the circle to get a different kind of answer that time. No marks are set.

After circling a question, handwrite one of the marks below outside the circle, and that answer follows the mark's prompt. A mark is really just a prompt written in advance: when the AI reads your letters, it answers by that text.
· 1 to 3 letters, English letters only, case doesn't matter.
· The name shows on the answer's type label.
· A rough prompt is fine: tap AI polish to have the AI rewrite it to fit Quanwen, and Restore if you don't like the result.
· Changes are saved when you leave this page.
How the AI should answer in this mode, e.g. explain the idea with an everyday example
Go back to the default marks, gg Roots and j Solve? Marks you changed or added will be removed.
The prompt is empty (a rough idea is fine; then tap AI polish)
%1$d mark(s) were incomplete or had duplicate letters and were not saved.
Write a rough idea or a name first, then tap AI polish.

Write together (experimental): write a question mark (?) and pause for 1 second; the AI writes its answer right after your question. You can erase the AI\'s writing. If your question is unclear, the AI asks on a new line; write your answer on the page, end it with a full stop (。), and it answers again.

Write together: in a notebook, writing a question mark (?) asks the AI, and it writes the answer right on the page after your question, with no answer box. If your question is unclear, the AI asks on a new line; write your answer on the page, end it with a full stop (。), and it answers again. You can also switch it on and off from the notebook toolbar.
Yes, I\'m here. ① x² = 4 ⇒ x = ±2
Allow Quanwen to install apps on the page that opens, then come back and tap Download and install again.
Nothing yet. Tap the circle button on the float bar and circle a question.
No key yet: tap to enter or import one
Quanwen sends a screenshot of your notes to the AI, so pick a model that reads images. You can keep keys for several services and switch any time.
Keys stay on this device and go only to the service you picked.
Paste a key and Quanwen works out which service it\'s for, picks a model that reads images, and tests it. For a relay, paste the address and the key together.
Detecting… (trying the likely services one at a time, stopping at the first match)
✓ Test passed and it\'s now in use. Go circle a question.
The test didn\'t pass; see the message below, then try another model or check the key.
Imported %1$s, but couldn\'t fetch its models: enter a model name below and test.
No key found. A key is usually a long string of letters and digits, often starting with sk-.
Couldn\'t tell which service this key is for. Pick the service below and enter the key there.
None of the services tried accepted this key. Check that you copied all of it.
Couldn\'t fetch the model list (%1$s); pick from the suggested ones for now.
Delete this custom endpoint? Its key is deleted too.
Connected, but it didn\'t read the word in the image (reply: \"%1$s\"). Quanwen needs a model that reads images; try another.
This model doesn\'t seem to read images; pick one that does: %1$s
Voice transcription needs an OpenAI key. You\'re using another service: add an OpenAI key under AI service as well, or ask with the pad or by typing.
